projectName: Positive proof — tasks that cross boundaries with exact contracts

tasks.title: Persist session records
tasks.description: Crosses the storage boundary: writes session records to the session store and reads them back.
acceptanceCriteria: Session record written on login and read on the next request
v1 session records remain readable after the v2 addition

data_contract.versioning: schema v2; v1 records remain readable
data_contract.compatibility: backward compatible: new optional fields only

tasks.title: Call the payment adapter and emit telemetry
tasks.description: Crosses two boundaries: an adapter to a foreign payment system and a telemetry sink.
acceptanceCriteria: The provider version is pinned and recorded
A telemetry event is emitted for every authorization

data_contract.compatibility: pinned version; upgrade is a separate migration
additive only; consumers ignore unknown fields
